description: Look up a French company or establishment in INSEE's official SIRENE business registry. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "who is French company X", "details for SIREN/SIRET …", legal name, activity (NAF/APE code), address, headcount band, creation date, active/ceased status. Pass a 9-digit SIREN (legal unit) or 14-digit SIRET (establishment).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own INSEE SIRENE API key. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

identifier.description: A SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits), e.g. "552032534" (Danone).
